_doc: How tall each kind of thing should stand, in tiles (scripts/world3d/scale_guide.gd): [lowest, highest]. A model measured outside its range is scaled to the nearest edge (ScaleGuide.factor), so sizes agree with each other (a flower never stands as tall as a tree) without editing every model. Ranges apply to a thing standing alone; packed fields (orchards, gardens) scale each member from there.

decor._doc: Decorations are drawn this much bigger than they are modelled: FarmVille's were chunky and filled their tile. `default` for every decoration, `ids` for the ones that already fill their footprint.
